caption: LUM-1271 reference completeness (120x70): the /help and /hotkeys bodies must render in full, with no row hard-clipped at the right margin. This scenario removes the scroll window from the question, so it asserts the content invariant; lum1267-interaction-assertions.json asserts the 34-row scroll/tail interaction.
notes: Why 70 rows: the expanded startup header plus composer/status take ~22 rows, so the transcript window is ~48 rows; the wrapped /help body is ~34 rows and fits, so every command row and the whole key table are in one frame. The pre-fix renderer (b5769b585) could not produce this frame at any height: it emitted 11 hard-clipped rows whose text was truncated mid-word, which is what the `reject` needles pin.
Panel 2 asserts /clear actually clears the message view, which keeps panel 3's /hotkeys block inside the window and covers the /clear command as a side effect.

The reject needles 'keys: Enter submit promp', 'accept autocomplete commands:' and 'abort streamin' are the exact cuts the pre-LUM-1261 renderer produced (see docs/TUI_LUM1271_*.md); they cannot appear once each source line is wrapped instead of clipped.

panels.label: 1. /help -> the whole slash-command reference and the key table in one frame
expect: /copy     copy the last assistant message to the clipboard
/tree     navigate the session tree and switch branches
/fork     branch a new session from a user message
/clone    copy the current session into a new session file
/compact  summarize the conversation prefix to free context
/extensions list loaded extensions and what they register
Home / End  jump to the start / end of the chat log

reject.why: the whole reference fits in the ~48-row window, so the log stays at the bottom and the jump-to-latest pill must not be rendered
pre-fix the reference was clipped into hard-cut rows and this merges what are now the separate 'keys:' heading and 'Enter submit prompt' rows

panels.label: 3. /hotkeys -> the whole chord table in one frame
expect: Ctrl+O           expand or collapse tool output
Alt+H            expand or collapse the startup header

reject.why: pre-fix the clip landed here: the truncated rendering joined the chord row 'Tab ... path completion / accept autocomplete' with the section heading 'commands:', which only exists in that clipped rendering
